title: Rate Lock Commitment Lock Desk Hours, Confirmation Time and Expiration Time
content:
For every **Rate Lock Commitment** product, the Larkspur lock desk works to the same clock. The figures below are stated in US Eastern time.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Lock desk starts pricing | Lock desk cutoff | After-cutoff or non-business-day request priced on next business day's opening rate sheet | Confirmation within (business days of the request) | Lock expires at (on the expiration date) | Expiration date on a non-business day rolls forward to next business day at no cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 09:30 | 16:00 | Yes | 1 | 17:00 | Yes |

### What each column means

- **Lock desk starts pricing**: the time the lock desk starts pricing on a business day.
- **Lock desk cutoff**: the last time stamp on a business day that is priced on that day's rate sheet.
- **Next-day pricing**: a request time-stamped after the cutoff, or on a non-business day, is priced on the next business day's opening rate sheet.
- **Confirmation**: the number of business days after the request within which the lock desk confirms a lock.
- **Expiration time**: the time of day on the expiration date at which the lock expires.
- **Roll-forward**: an expiration date that falls on a non-business day rolls forward to the next business day at no cost.

### Points of reading

- A request stamped at 16:00 exactly on a business day is within the cutoff for every product; one stamped at 16:01 is after it.
- A lock whose expiration date is a business day remains in force on that day until 17:00 US Eastern.
